 As a New Grad Field Services Technician \- Electrical Testing at Shermco Industries, you will be joining a company that not only prioritizes technical excellence but also embodies a culture of integrity, safety, and innovation.  You will have the unique opportunity to work in data centers, where you will be involved in maintaining and testing electrical systems critical to their operation.  Shermco Industries is seeking a New Grad Field Service Technician

**On\-Site Technical Support:** 
 Provide on\-site assistance with electrical systems, covering installations, testing, and troubleshooting for voltages from 480V to 600kV.

 Diagnose and resolve technical issues efficiently, including switchgear, circuit breaker, and relay calibration.
   

  

**Client Interaction:** 
 Maintain professional client relationships, addressing inquiries and providing expert support, including timely responses to emergency calls.
   

  

**Documentation:** 
 Keep detailed records of service activities, including reports, client feedback, and necessary product modifications.
   

  

**Collaboration:** 
 Work closely with cross\-functional teams to support continuous improvement and innovation projects.
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Requirements**
**Preferred Education:** 
 Prefer an Associate’s degree from an accredited 2 year technical college in Electrical Power \& Controls (EPC) or related field.
   

  

**Experience:** 
 Relevant experience performing switchgear testing and troubleshooting is an asset.
   

  

**Technical Skills:** 
 Good PC skills, including email, internet, data entry, and Microsoft Excel; experience with PowerDB is a plus.

 Must be able to work safely and adhere to all electrical safety procedures.

 Prefer OSHA 30 hour, MSHA, NFPA 70\-E, CPR/First Aid/BBP/AED training; training on each can be provided by Shermco.
   

  

**Travel:** 
 Must be able to drive daily locally/regionally and be available for periodic overnight travel.

**Overview**
**About Susquehanna**
 Susquehanna is a global quantitative trading firm founded by a group of friends who share a passion for game theory and probabilistic thinking. We have incorporated this approach into our culture, where you will find relentless problem solvers within each of our core disciplines: Trading, Technology, and Quantitative Research. From offices around the world, our employees collaborate to make optimal decisions and are driven by the desire to achieve winning results together.
   

  

**What We Do**
 We are experts in trading essentially all listed financial products and asset classes, with a focus on derivatives trading. Through market making and market taking, we handle millions of trading transactions around the world every day, providing liquidity and ensuring competitive prices for buyers and sellers. While our presence in the market is broad, our trading desks are highly specialized, allowing for a deep understanding of unique drivers of each asset class.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 Our Platform Services team is an integral part of the Compute and Storage Platforms (CASP) team at Susquehanna and shares responsibility for building and managing all 15,000\+ servers and 250\+ PB of storage that composes our critical trade focused infrastructure. Joining Platform Services is the first step in building an engineering career with Susquehanna and provides you with opportunities to:
   

  

**Rotate across technology spaces**
 As part of the team, you will be able to rotate with senior engineers specializing in Windows, Linux, Virtualization, Storage, and open source technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, Jenkins, Ansible, and Grafana. During these rotations you will partner with engineers to learn the fundamentals of their spaces and help them solve complex problems from building out new environments, evaluating and creating new applications, performance tuning, automation, and configuration management.
   

  

**Work with mentors**
 In each rotation you will be paired with one or more mentors that will guide you through your technical growth and Susquehanna's environment. In addition to dealing with day\-to\-day project work, together you will pinpoint your areas of interest and avenues for growth. You will also work closely with the rest of our teams through design/white board sessions, problem solving discussions, and ongoing project and team updates.
   

  

**Address and solve challenging technical problems**
 At Susquehanna we want your help to solve challenging problems! Partner with technologists across Susquehanna's environment to troubleshoot application, network, hardware, and other issues while learning and debating the best solution to fit the scenario. You will have the freedom to test and implement your solutions at scale in our onsite labs consisting of over 600 physical and virtual servers.
   

  

**Engage with bleeding edge technology**
 Susquehanna is always looking at the latest technology to see where we can increase speed and performance for competitive advantage while managing risk and enhancing stability. You may have the opportunity to help test out new hardware that isn’t generally available (server hardware, network cards, flash storage), work on emerging platforms geared toward container orchestration (Kubernetes, Service Fabric), or work on high performance clustered environments responsible for driving our quantitative trading.
   

  

**The shift for this role rotates daily between three shifts: 7:00am\-4:00pm(Production Lead), 9:00am\-6:00pm and 11:00am\-8:00pm(Late Support). There is one Production Lead and Late Support per day and the rest of the team works 9:00am\-6:00pm. Applicants must be willing to work these shifts**
**What We're Looking For**
 What we’re looking for:
   

  

* BS in Information Technology, Computer Science or Engineering, or a similar technical major.
* Knowledge of computer architecture, OS and network concepts.
* A passion for technology, learning, and finding creative ways to solve hard problems.
* Strong personal initiative and excellent communication skills.
* Experience with any of the following a plus: Python, PowerShell, Bash, Linux, Windows, building computer systems or networks.
* Visa sponsorship is available for this position.

******About The Role:******
 You'll be joining our MacOS Sensor Foundation team supporting CrowdStrike's flagship Falcon endpoint protection platform. This team is responsible for core sensor components in user space (C\+\+, Swift). We build and maintain the MacOS sensor, creating and/or building a platform for products and features that empower customers with prevention, detection, and response capabilities.
   

  

**Location:**
* This role is hybrid, requiring 2\-3 days per week on\-site at one of the posted locations.


******What You’ll Do:******
 CrowdStrike Falcon Host is a two\-component security product. One component is a “sensor”: a driver installed on client machines that observes system activity and recognizes malicious behavior, then provides on\-box prevention capability and remote telemetry to the Falcon Host cloud. The sensor processes thousands of events per second to provide deep visibility into operations on the endpoint, and performs rich correlation and computation to identify malicious events and blocks malicious activity.
   

  

 The cloud component aggregates sensor telemetry for each customer’s network, correlates malicious behavior across multiple machines, and presents our customers’ operations teams with a prioritized summary of the threats detected in their environments.
   

  

 This is an Engineer 3 \- macOS Engineer role in the engineering team that delivers the sensor (lightweight agent) on macOS. Engineers in the team own design and development of core features on the platform. Features will cross\-cut most core OS subsystems such as file system, memory, process, and networking. Many features are also built in a way that they will have shared components across Windows and Linux.
   

  

****Responsibilities:****
* Design and develop software for deployment on macOS systems
* Own features from design to delivery
* Collaborate with multi\-functional team in various physical locations
* Troubleshoot issues with the product as reported from customers responsively
* Other projects as assigned


****What You’ll Need****
* Can develop high\-quality code in C/C\+\+ and Swift, and can demonstrate that capability, through job experience, schoolwork, or contributions to community projects
* Experience on macOS developing product code with the following characteristics:
* high concurrency requirements needing strong use of multi\-threading high reliability requirements
* detailed requirements on low\-level operating characteristics (memory usage, efficient performance, correct conformance to external standards)
* Experience working on a team to ship major features and releases
* Able to communicate, collaborate, and work effectively in a distributed team
* Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision\-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

* Prior Experience working on Endpoint product or within Cyber Security space
